audit_method: Offline strict JSON with duplicate-key and nonfinite rejection; exactly answers key; unique integer indices 0..3; set-exact scoring. Expected rederived via packet order from frozen blind labels, then compared with packet expected. No student/model calls.
limits: Only the four authorized input files were read in this execution audit; no main-audit summaries were used. Frozen files were not modified.
Reported token hashes were compared for equality; token arrays and tokenizer were not supplied, so hashes cannot independently reconstruct tokens. Packet messages were compared directly.
MU4 remains a separate lower-tier paired cross-framework item in details; family totals are descriptive and do not make it an independent compositional ability.
Closed condition means no appended source; MU1–MU3 already state governing rules, so these scores do not measure pure knowledge retrieval.
Correctness changes under identical prompts are observed output facts only; no internal mechanism or cause is inferred.
